description: The pure steps from YuNet's and Face Mesh V2's outputs to a FrameFace on Windows (ADR-R48 Windows, package W2), on synthetic tensors and landmark sets, with the calibration of shared/catalog/frame-models.json. Generated by tools/fixtures/clip-frames/generate_face_fields.py; C# FrameFaceFieldsVectorTests replays every case, comparing numbers within 1e-9 relative.

calibration.basis: Provisional: the acceptance against the Mac failed (see evaluation.failed), so this calibration cannot be enabled. Fitted by tools/frames/calibrate (W7) on 24 subjects of US federal public-domain NASA video and checked on 13 held-out subjects (split by subject; manifest tools/frames/calibrate/manifest.json, SHA-256 e28d44db2d066d351ff7cf9f5536fed7e049dcce9e23a3ee7dc4748095afdc10); no frames are kept. The study's fixed gates stay for minimumFaceWidth (1 fit faces narrower than the size gate), lumaLow (1 fit faces darker than the low luma gate), lumaHigh (0 fit faces brighter than the high luma gate), clippedFraction (0 fit faces more clipped than the clipping gate): a gate is fitted only from 30 faces past it. The sharpness range, eyes-open span and facing span are the study's; pitch0 and the weights are fitted.
calibration.reference: Apple Vision, macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), AppleFrameVision request set with M1: VNDetectFaceRectanglesRequest revision 3, then VNDetectFaceLandmarksRequest and VNDetectFaceCaptureQualityRequest on its largest face, beside VNRecognizeTextRequest (fast) and VNDetectRectanglesRequest
